name: Force Earnings Sync on a Submission With Real Changes
description: FLP-2033 (force plus genuine changes). SLD POSTs a draft apprenticeship and Commitments approves it, which releases on-programme earnings once. Support sets ForceEarningsSync and SLD PUTs a later expected end date and a new Maths course in the same submission. Earnings recalculates on-programme and creates the Maths course as usual, but the outer API skips the release it would normally compute and releases All with no keys only, which covers on-programme and the new Maths course. Support then clears the flag. Expect on-programme 2 (approval, forced) and Maths 1. On-programme at 3 or Maths at 2 means the computed release was sent as well as the forced one. Any aim ref other than 400/404/500/DECIMAL earns the SLD stub's default value. Needs the ForceEarningsSync column in the local Learning DB. Bus messages are asserted from EventHub's ReceivedEvents, so EventHub must be running locally.

steps.name: SLD Changes the Expected End Date and Adds Maths (all earnings released once)

assertions.name: The forced resubmission is recorded with ExpectedEndDate, EnglishAndMaths and ForceEarningsSync
On-programme is released once more and the new Maths course once, by the forced release
Nothing is released twice by the forced resubmission, and every release carries the learner key
